chunkheat.config.title: ChunkHeat Settings
chunkheat.config.seconds_tooltip: Sampling seconds, converted by game ticks.
chunkheat.config.relative_tooltip: When checked, colors are judged by the relative size within this scan: the heaviest chunk is shown in red and every other chunk is compared against it, making relatively laggy chunks easier to spot when the overall load is low. When unchecked, colors are judged by the fixed red threshold below.
chunkheat.config.red_at_tooltip: A chunk costing at least this value is shown in the highest red level; chunks below it fade continuously from green through yellow to red. When "Relative mode" is checked this value is not used and cannot be adjusted.
chunkheat.config.opacity_tooltip: Opacity of the heat fill. Range 0.05 ~ 1.00; the smaller the value, the clearer the base map underneath.
chunkheat.config.weak_tooltip: Show chunks with load level 32 or above.
chunkheat.config.reset_tooltip: Restore all settings to their default values.
